Name: Baldew Valley - Pelican Town's Follicular Crisis
Author: Shawnana
Description:
Is it the glowing runoff from the sewer? Big Joja? A misplaced hex from a disgruntled witch? The townsfolk aren't questioning a follicular crisis, they’ve simply embraced their beautiful bald lives.

How to Install
To get the smooth look of Baldew Valley in your game, you must have these two things installed first:
1. Download SMAPI - Download here: https://smapi.io/
2. Download Content Patcher - Download here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915 
-
3. Download the mod & Unzip: Download the Baldew Valley file from the 'Files' tab here on Nexus. Unzip (extract) the folder.
Move to Mods Folder: Copy the folder named [CP] Baldew Valley and paste it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Default Steam path: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

Tips:
Unzipped Mod folder structure - 
 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
📁 ConsoleCommands (Pre-installed by SMAPI)
📁 SaveBackup (Pre-installed by SMAPI)
📁 ContentPatcher (The "translator" mod you downloaded)
📁 [CP] Baldew Valley (The actual visual mod)


Find and double click to launch game: StardewModdingAPI.exe in 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
